name: uwu-code
description: Turns VS Code into a kawaii IDE: pastel themes and file icons, a full window makeover with splash screen, mascot, sparkles and confetti ♡

commands.title: Enable Kawaii Workbench (turn VS Code into uwu IDE) ✿

uwu.sparkleOnSave.description: Burst hearts and sparkles at the cursor when you save.

uwu.gutterHearts.description: Show a little heart in the gutter on lines you changed since the last save.

uwu.errorKaomoji.description: Show a sad kaomoji at the end of lines with errors.

uwu.mascot.description: Show a kaomoji mascot in the status bar that reacts to errors and saves.

uwu.workbench.splash.description: Kawaii Workbench: show the uwu IDE splash screen at startup.

uwu.workbench.clickBursts.description: Kawaii Workbench: little heart bursts wherever you click.

uwu.workbench.typingSparkles.description: Kawaii Workbench: sparkles pop out of the cursor while you type.

uwu.workbench.mascot.description: Kawaii Workbench: the floating mascot that reacts to saves and errors (click it for pats).

uwu.workbench.confetti.description: Kawaii Workbench: confetti rain when you save.

colors.description: Colour of the error kaomoji shown after lines with errors.
